# jellyfin_api_key (Resource)

Manages an API key in Jellyfin. API keys provide authentication tokens for external applications to access the Jellyfin API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "jellyfin_api_key" "example" {
  app_name = "my-application"
}

output "api_key" {
  value     = jellyfin_api_key.example.access_token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_name` (String) The application name for the API key. Defaults to `Terraform`.

### Read-Only

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) The generated access token (API key). This is set by Jellyfin upon creation.
- `id` (String, Sensitive) The API key resource identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An API key is imported by its app name, or by its access token when several keys share the app name.
terraform import jellyfin_api_key.example "my-application"
terraform import jellyfin_api_key.example <access-token>
```
